status: exploratory; frozen before new all-family estimates, after parent results and Bian narrative exposure
source: GSE211335; same 12 animals and 5423 author endothelial cells as parent A21, not new replication
normalization: Raw all-gene counts summed per animal/state, CPM then log2(CPM+1); author denominator sensitivity holds numerators fixed as in parent amendment
statistics: Each animal is the unit; technical pools aggregated. Paired state contrasts, split by day. Mean, median, full observed range, signs, detected cells and counts. No P values, fitted pathway score, pooled correlation, trajectory or cross-day longitudinal pairing.
gene_mapping_gate: Every requested symbol must map uniquely in all three matrices; absent/ambiguous stops before estimates for documented amendment. Zero observations remain zeros, not gene absence.

candidate_rule.purpose: Exploratory RNA nomination only; no receptor compensation claim
candidate_rule.criteria: Among Fzd1-10 excluding Fzd4, transitional enrichment: per injury day >=2 pairs, positive mean and >=2/3 positive pairs, >=5 detected transitional cells across eligible animals; satisfy >=2 injury days at both 20- and 10-cell floors. Report floor50 separately and all ten receptors regardless of nomination.
candidate_rule.validation: Requires independent injury cohort with matching source-defined major/transitional identity independent of Fzd/canonical/cycling genes and resolved biological units; a coarse CAP1/CAP2 comparison is not validation.

functional_reanalysis.target: Bian2024 Figure7 source datasets: Fzd4-restoration versus empty vector in endothelial Foxf1-deficient tumor context
outcomes: collagen IV area relative to CD31 area
functional_reanalysis.units: Source-resolved animals; repeated image fields nested; do not infer animal identity from row order across endpoints
functional_reanalysis.gate: Numerical tables and biological unit mapping needed; otherwise evidence audit only. No digitization of figures.
functional_reanalysis.summaries: Unpaired individual animal points, n, mean/median/range and raw mean differences if eligible; no new inferential tests, no causal mediation or cross-context pooling.

priority3: Separate self-renewal and aerocyte descendant output per initial viable labelled population; no functional fit without linked Fzd4 perturbation, initial state, lineage, viability and vascular-performance data.
known_exposure: Bian2024 figures/narrative (including reported FZD4 dominance and FZD6 non-capillary expression)
Original Nb2 Fzd-family observations; no independence claimed
